title: The Hidden Color Clue
intro: This quiz follows Maya and Theo as they learn how camouflage helps animals blend into their surroundings.

choices: A way animals make loud sounds
A way animals blend into their surroundings
questions.explanation: Camouflage is a way animals blend into their surroundings.

questions.prompt: Why was the green tree frog hard to see?
choices: Its color matched the green leaves
It was too small to see
questions.explanation: The green tree frog was hard to see because its color matched the green leaves.

questions.prompt: How can camouflage help prey animals?
choices: It can make them easier for predators to find
It can help them hide from predators
It can help them grow wings
It can make them run slower
questions.explanation: Camouflage can help prey animals hide from predators.

choices: It helps them approach prey without being noticed
questions.explanation: Camouflage helps predators approach prey without being noticed.

questions.prompt: Which animal would be best camouflaged in a snowy habitat?
questions.explanation: A white Arctic fox would be best camouflaged in a snowy habitat.
